more_info.overview: Starch sodium octenyl succinate is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include milk-based drinks and similar products intended for young children, unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %, foods for infants and young children. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Starch is esterified with octenylsuccinic anhydride. The product is a chemically modified carbohydrate.
